items.text: Added SetVehicleLoad limit and refined vehicle seat haptic feedback.
First‑person laser sights are functional again, restoring visual aiming cues.
Explosives attached to solar panels now scale correctly, ensuring intended damage.
Triangle spiral stairs now correctly contribute to base upkeep calculations.
Refrigeration units require at least 10% arctic biome coverage to function, preventing unintended cooling in tiny arctic patches.
Boat ownership privileges have been fixed, preventing loss of control when using the privilege cache.
Halloween DLC lights are now craftable with proper stack sizes and costs, and the alien suit’s hitbox now blocks the torso instead of the legs.
Gamepad stick drift is eliminated by ignoring input from inactive controllers, and duck‑latching now stays within gamepad logic, fixing menu‑escape issues.
Magazine drops now use the same system as the glass AK, making their spawn behavior consistent with that weapon.

2026-10-12.summary:
### Vehicles
- Added SetVehicleLoad limit and refined vehicle seat haptic feedback.

### Combat & Tools
- First‑person laser sights are functional again, restoring visual aiming cues.
- Explosives attached to solar panels now scale correctly, ensuring intended damage.

### Base & Upkeep
- Triangle spiral stairs now correctly contribute to base upkeep calculations.
- Refrigeration units require at least 10% arctic biome coverage to function, preventing unintended cooling in tiny arctic patches.
- Boat ownership privileges have been fixed, preventing loss of control when using the privilege cache.

### Items & DLC
- Halloween DLC lights are now craftable with proper stack sizes and costs, and the alien suit’s hitbox now blocks the torso instead of the legs.

### Controls
- Gamepad stick drift is eliminated by ignoring input from inactive controllers, and duck‑latching now stays within gamepad logic, fixing menu‑escape issues.

### Loot & Inventory
- Magazine drops now use the same system as the glass AK, making their spawn behavior consistent with that weapon.

items.text: Chainlink gates now open at normal speed instead of being twice as slow.
Spraycan reskin now correctly applies the chosen material on low‑quality double doors.
Vehicle mount points can now be sized and overlapped, allowing a large flatbed mount to replace two small mounts; you can still load two sheep but not two cows.
Livestock will now eat from troughs even when grass is present, and the amount of grass reduces the food value they receive.
Terrain configs now load correctly in the demo, preventing missing or broken terrain for players.
Building privilege checks are now cached, cutting the check time from ~4.6 ms to ~0.5 ms in large bases, reducing building lag.

2026-10-11.summary:
### Structures
- Chainlink gates now open at normal speed instead of being twice as slow.

### Cosmetics
- Spraycan reskin now correctly applies the chosen material on low‑quality double doors.

### Vehicles & Mounts
- Vehicle mount points can now be sized and overlapped, allowing a large flatbed mount to replace two small mounts; you can still load two sheep but not two cows.

### Livestock & Farming
- Livestock will now eat from troughs even when grass is present, and the amount of grass reduces the food value they receive.

### Gameplay & Balance
- Terrain configs now load correctly in the demo, preventing missing or broken terrain for players.
- Building privilege checks are now cached, cutting the check time from ~4.6 ms to ~0.5 ms in large bases, reducing building lag.

items.text: Apples now spawn exactly at the location of their loot container on trees, changing where they can be collected.
Fixed laserbeam job processing to correctly use current materials, preventing resource loss and ensuring builds function as intended.

2026-10-10.summary:
### Resources & Farming
- Apples now spawn exactly at the location of their loot container on trees, changing where they can be collected.

### Gameplay & Balance
- Fixed laserbeam job processing to correctly use current materials, preventing resource loss and ensuring builds function as intended.
